scripts.test:all: vitest --run && npm run docker:test && npm run docker:test:integration
scripts.docker:test:chromium: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.docker:test:firefox: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.docker:test:webkit: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.docker:test:ui: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm --service-ports -e CI=false playwright npx playwright test --ui-host=0.0.0.0 --ui-port=9323
scripts.docker:test:mocked:ui: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm --service-ports -e CI=false playwright npx playwright test --config=playwright.mocked.config.ts --ui-host=0.0.0.0 --ui-port=9323
scripts.docker:test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration run --rm playwright npx playwright test --config=playwright.integration.config.ts
scripts.docker:test:integration:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration up -d && docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration run --rm playwright bash -c 'until curl -fs http://api:1323/health; do sleep 1; done && until curl -fs http://centrifugo:8000/health; do sleep 1; done' && docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml run --rm playwright npx playwright test --config=playwright.integration.config.ts; docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration down -v
scripts.docker:test:integration:ui: docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration up -d && docker compose -f docker-compose.playwright.yml --profile integration run --rm --service-ports -e CI=false playwright bash -c 'until curl -fs http://api:1323/health; do sleep 1; done && npx playwright test --config=playwright.integration.config.ts --ui-host=0.0.0.0 --ui-port=9323'
